title: Rogers Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Chandler, Arizona, October 27, 2026: Rogers Corporation (NYSE: ROG) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026.
body_markdown:
##### Release Date: 10/27/2026


- Net sales of $236.1 million increased 9.3% year-over-year (YoY)
- Gross margin of 34.2% increased 70 basis points YoY
- Net income of $22.6 million increased by $14.0 million YoY
- Adjusted EBITDA of $47.7 million increased by $10.5 million YoY
- Diluted earnings per share of $1.26, increased by $0.78 YoY
- Adjusted earnings per share of $1.39 increased by $0.49 YoY


Chandler, Arizona, October 27, 2026: Rogers Corporation (NYSE: ROG) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026.


"Third quarter results demonstrate the continued strengthening of Rogers’ financial performance, with year-over-year growth in sales, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted earnings per share,” stated Ali El-Haj, Rogers’ President and CEO. “Improved execution, closer customer engagement and a more efficient operating structure continue to translate into stronger results.”


"For the fourth quarter we expect further year-over-year improvement in our financial performance, as we build on our progress in commercial execution and operational effectiveness. Our growth strategy is centered on leveraging Rogers' proven capabilities and deep customer relationships to drive growth in core markets and high-potential adjacent opportunities. With a disciplined focus on execution and a healthy balance sheet, we are well positioned to translate our growth opportunities into stronger earnings and shareholder returns."


### Financial Overview


GAAP Results (dollars in millions, except per share amounts) Q3 2026 Q2 2026 Q3 2025


Net Sales $236.1 $216.8 $216.0


Gross Margin 34.2% 32.5% 33.5%


Net Income $22.6 $13.6 $8.6


Diluted Earnings Per Share $1.26 $0.76 $0.48


Adjusted Earnings Per Diluted Share 1 $1.39 $0.92 $0.90


Adjusted EBITDA 1 $47.7 $37.6 $37.2


Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities $41.4 $24.4 $28.9


Free Cash Flow 1 $35.4 $18.3 $21.2


1 Adjusted Earnings Per Diluted Share, Adjusted EBITDA and Free Cash Flow are non-GAAP measures. A reconciliation of non-GAAP to GAAP measures is provided in the schedules included below.


### Q3 2026 Summary of Results


Net sales of $236.1 million increased 9.3%, or $20.1 million, versus the third quarter of 2025. The higher sales were concentrated primarily in the electronics and communications and automotive end markets. Currency exchange rates favorably affected net sales in the third quarter of 2026 by $2.4 million compared to the prior year.


GAAP earnings per diluted share were $1.26 compared to $0.48 in Q3 2025. On an adjusted basis, earnings were $1.39 per diluted share compared to earnings of $0.90 per diluted share in the third quarter of 2025. The increase in adjusted earnings resulted primarily from stronger sales and improved margins.


Third quarter ending cash and cash equivalents were $206.1 million and short-term investments were $30.3 million. These balances together increased by $25.0 million compared to the prior quarter. Net cash provided by operating activities was $41.4 million and capital expenditures were $6.0 million. Share repurchases totaled $9.3 million.

### Conference Call and Additional Information


A conference call to discuss the results for the third quarter will take place today, Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 5:00 pm ET. A live webcast of the event and the accompanying presentation can be accessed on the Rogers Corporation website at[https://www.rogerscorp.com/investors](https://www.rogerscorp.com/investors) .


### About Rogers Corporation


Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) is a global leader in engineered materials to power, protect and connect our world. Rogers delivers innovative solutions to help our customers solve their toughest material challenges. Rogers’ advanced electronic and elastomeric materials are used in applications for EV/HEV, automotive safety and radar systems, mobile devices, renewable energy, wireless infrastructure, energy-efficient motor drives, industrial equipment and more. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Rogers operates manufacturing facilities in the United States (U.S.), Asia and Europe, with sales offices worldwide.
